text:
sara-partnerships: Quick heads-up — kicking off an entry preflight for AWS/GCP/Azure storefront listings for Redwood Inference. Scope: initial account setup, KMS/SAML, legal T&Cs, SKU/trial packaging, and billing mapping. Need owners and any blockers.

mike-legal: I can own T&Cs + EULA localization. Will need the target geos and any custom data residency language.

alex-product: I'll take SKU strategy and trial entitlements. Proposal: two SKUs (starter/enterprise) + 14-day trial flag.

jasmine-eng: I'll handle the technical manifest and IAM/KMS requirements. Tom — can you confirm network/KMS constraints for Private offers?

tom-ops: Yup — for Private Offer we need customer KMS key ARN + VPC endpoint details. Also need the list of regions we plan to publish.

sara-partnerships: Regions = us-west-2, us-east-1, europe-west1, europe-north1 for initial launch. We can expand later.

alex-product: For billing mapping, do we map to existing metering or create a new plan? Suggest align with usage-based metering + seat add-on.

mike-legal: Seat add-on ok. For usage billing we need clear unit definition (tokens vs request units). Define in docs or legal will push back.

jasmine-eng: Working draft of marketplace manifest below — placeholder values. Anyone see issues?

```json
{
  "offerName": "Redwood Inference",
  "skus": [
    {"id": "rdi-starter", "name": "Starter", "trial_days": 14},
    {"id": "rdi-enterprise", "name": "Enterprise", "trial_days": 14}
  ],
  "regions": ["us-west-2","us-east-1","europe-west1","europe-north1"],
  "kms_required": true
}
```

tom-ops: manifest looks fine. Add "private_offer": true/false flag per SKU. Also note: for Azure we need tenant subscription mapping; GCP needs publisher IAM.

sara-partnerships: Action list: 1) mike-legal to draft EULA + geo/residency clause (owner: mike-legal) 2) alex-product to finalize SKU names & billing unit (owner: alex-product) 3) jasmine-eng to produce final manifest + IAM checklist (owner: jasmine-eng) 4) tom-ops to confirm KMS ARNs and region-specific networking (owner: tom-ops).

mike-legal: ETA EULA draft by Tue EOD. Will drop a short checklist of localization needs.

alex-product: I'll post billing mapping options and recommended metrics by Mon. Need input on whether tokens or request-units is preferred from eng.

jasmine-eng: I'll assemble IAM/KMS playbook and include terraform snippet for publisher onboarding. Example snippet soon.

deploy-bot: Reminder — marketplace-assets-bot will attempt to validate logos/manifest when uploaded. Failed validations will post in #partnerships.

sara-partnerships: Great. If no objections let's sync Wed 10am PT to walk through artifacts before initial upload. :calendar: 

tom-ops: Works for me.

alex-product: SGTM.

mike-legal: I'll be there.

jasmine-eng: adding initial tasks to the shared drive and will link in thread when ready.

sara-partnerships: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with the calendar invite + checklist. :rocket:
